hints.title: Iterate Divisors Above Threshold
hints.text: Only divisors strictly greater than the threshold can form valid connections between cities.

hints.title: Union Multiples of Divisors
hints.text: For each divisor d > threshold, connect d with its multiples 2d, 3d, and so on up to n.

hints.title: Disjoint Set Connectivity Queries
hints.text: Use disjoint set union to query whether u and v belong to the same connected component.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Computing gcd for all O(n^2) pairs takes O(n^2 log n), which is far too slow for n = 10000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sieve-like multiple enumeration takes O(n log n) total unions, allowing near constant query time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should use disjoint set union over multiples of each valid factor d.
